1.text: Nkwiriye kwirata nubwo bitagira umumaro. Reka mbabwire ibyo neretswe n'ibyo nahishuriwe n'Umwami wacu.

2.text: Nzi umuntu wo muri Kristo wazamuwe akajyanwa mu ijuru rya gatatu, ubu hashize imyaka cumi n'ine (niba yari mu mubiri simbizi, cyangwa niba atari mu mubiri na byo simbizi bizi Imana).

3.text: Kandi nzi yuko uwo muntu (niba yari ari mu mubiri, cyangwa niba yari atari mu mubiri, simbizi bizi Imana),

4.text: yazamuwe akajyanwa muri Paradiso akumva ibitavugwa, ibyo umuntu adakwiriye kuvuga.

5.text: Ku bw'uwo muntu ndirata ariko ku bwanjye sinirata, keretse ku bw'intege nke zanjye.

6.text: Kandi nashaka kwirata sinaba umupfu, kuko navuga ukuri. Ariko ndarorereye kugira ngo hatagira untekereza ibiruta ibyo andebana cyangwa ibyo anyumvana.

7.text: Kandi kugira ngo ne guterwa kwishyira hejuru kurenze ibikwiriye ni uko nahishuriwe ibikomeye cyane, ni cyo cyatumye mpabwa igishākwe cyo mu mubiri, ari cyo ntumwa ya Satani yo kunkubita ibipfunsi, ngo ne kwishyira hejuru kurenza ibikwiriye.

8.text: Kuri icyo kintu ninginze Umwami wacu gatatu ngo kimvemo.

9.text: Ariko arampakanira ati “Ubuntu bwanjye buraguhagije, kuko aho intege nke ziri ari ho imbaraga zanjye zuzura.” Nuko nzanezerwa cyane kwirata intege nke zanjye, ngo imbaraga za Kristo zinzeho.

10.text: Ni cyo gituma ku bwa Kristo nzishimira intege nke zanjye no guhemurwa, nzishimira n'imibabaro no kurenganywa n'ibyago. Kuko iyo mbaye umunyantege nke ari ho ndushaho kugira imbaraga.

11.text: Mpindutse umupfu ariko ni mwe mwabimpase, kuko ibyari bikwiriye ari uko mba narogejwe namwe. Dore za ntumwa zikomeye cyane nta cyo zandushije, nubwo nta cyo ndi cyo.

12.text: Ni ukuri nakoze ibimenyetso byerekana ko ndi intumwa, mbikorera hagati yanyu nihangana cyane, ari byo bimenyetso n'ibitangaza n'imirimo ikomeye.

13.text: Mbese ayandi matorero yabarushije iki? Keretse yuko ubwanjye ntababereye ikirushya, mumbabarire iryo futi.

14.text: Dore ubu ni ubwa gatatu nitegura kuza iwanyu, kandi sinzababera ikirushya. Si ibyanyu nshaka ahubwo ni mwe ubwanyu nshaka, kuko abana badakwiriye guhunikira ababyeyi, ahubwo ababyeyi ni bo bakwiriye guhunikira abana.

15.text: Ku bwanjye nanezezwa cyane no gutanga ibyanjye, ndetse no kwitanga rwose nitangira ubugingo bwanyu, nubwo uko ndushaho kubakunda ari ko urukundo mwankundaga rurushaho kugabanuka.

16.text: Muravuga muti “Ibyo byo ni ko biri koko. Ubwawe ntiwaturemereye, ariko wagize ubwenge bwo kudutegesha uburiganya.”

17.text: Mbese koko, hari ubwo nigeze ngira umuntu wese mu bo nabatumyeho mbākisha indamu?

18.text: Nahuguye Tito mutumana na mwene Data wundi. Mbese hari indamu Tito yabenzeho? Si umwuka umwe twagendeyemo? Na we ntiyageze ikirenge mu cyanjye?

19.text: Uhereye kera mwibwira yuko tubireguraho, ariko imbere y'Imana, Kristo ni we utuvugiramo. Nuko bakundwa, byose tubivugiye kubakomeza.

20.text: Kuko ntinya yuko ubwo nzaza ahari nzasanga mumeze uko ntashaka, nanjye mugasanga meze uko mudashaka. Kandi ndatinya yuko ahari hazabaho intonganya n'ishyari, n'umujinya no kwirema ibice, no gusebanya no kuneguranira mu byongorerano, no kwihimbariza ubusa no kuvurungana.

21.text: Kandi ndatinya yuko ubwo nzaza Imana yanjye izongera kuncisha bugufi muri mwe, nanjye ndirire benshi bacumuye kera, ntibīhane ibyonona n'ubusambanyi n'iby'isoni nke bakoze.
